review.reference: APPROVE. Gates green: pytest 1787 passed, targeted 301 passed (incl 2 new e2e), ruff check + format clean, mypy 106 files clean. NET-NEGATIVE (NFR-001) PASS: lab_pdf.py +4/-145 (net -141), bmt.py +7/-40 (net -33) vs mission base; both strictly smaller. units.py +224 is WP01's stacked base (WP03's own delta +15/-4, not NFR-001-gated). 50f2546 is planning-doc-only (restores WP03 task file to mission-branch parity, zero functional code); owned_files compliant. EQUIVALENCE (load-bearing) VERIFIED via adversarial old-one-step-vs-new-two-step probe: 18 lab cases (mg/l->mg_per_dl, mEq/l Na, mmol/mol HbA1c affine, pmol/l B12, mmol/l Ca/Mg/P, g/l albumin, case-sensitive G/l, plus 3 that USED to skip as unit_mismatch and now become loader refusals - row absent either way) = 0 mismatches; 17 bmt long cases (lb/in/g/cm/mm + 4 flagged-bug unitless rows) = 0 mismatches. RULING unit_in-or-target: behavior-preserving, NOT worse than old - unitless-pounds weight row mislabels kg identically OLD and NEW; pre-existing bug carried forward unchanged (correct WP scope). RULING known_spellings(): justified (one home, no duplicate alias table); one over-generalization noted - it returns the full _ALIASES incl bmt tokens (kg/g/m/cm/in) which _split_value_and_unit consumes, so bmt tokens can theoretically split a bare lab cell (only lab:stool_weight canon=g collides), BUT proven UNREACHABLE: _parse_value extracts the number before the splitter guard fires, so no digit-bearing cell reaches it; latent, not a regression. C-005 six-question PASS: (1)existence - deletions delete two ladders, no new mechanism; (2)abstraction budget - one accessor, minor over-generality noted-not-blocking; (3)SHRINK - net -174 across parsers, headline gate met; (4)one-rule-one-chokepoint - conversion now solely at loader boundary; (5)process test - no ceremony added; (6)reuse ladder - delegates to WP01 units.py, no reimplementation.

Dry-run->DELETE->dry-run: all 12 assertions PASS - every labsheet-linked row gone, every legit row intact, second pass byte-identical no-op, zero FK violations. Delete ORDER is correct: facts-first (by source_id AND by ingest_batch) then ingest_skip then dim_source/ingest_run last; ingest_skip.batch_id->ingest_run FK held. C-005: Q1(existence) 5 dry-run + 7 delete stmts are defensive-necessary, not bloat - two bookkeeping trails (source_id join AND ingest_batch linkage) can diverge under a raw-SQL bypass, both must be covered; FR-009 satisfied.
